motivation: WSP149 exact numerical GF2 interpolation 192/192 but prior-memory gain 0pp vs no-memory and 158/256 transfer correct vs fully fitted CART 170/256; WSP150 separate in-flight source-free identifiability falsifier, not a qualification dependency.
scientific_question: Can source-blind, two-level Bayesian inference accumulate a reusable causal rule-form overhypothesis from earlier worlds, transfer it to unfamiliar causal identities using few real do-style actions, and maintain calibrated uncertainty, better than equally informed independent flat, fixed-prior and fully fitted conventional/symbolic controls?
scope: EXTERNAL PUBLIC SYNTHETIC DEVELOPMENT ONLY; NO protected original, no native Yggdrasil weights, no full model integration, no accepted-main mutation, no controller/scheduler, no paid APIs.

design.lower_hypotheses: nonempty causal object-subset S in 1..63; posterior over (form,S) conditioned only on charged (x,effect) intervention history
design.higher_hypothesis: shared cross-world prevalence pi of OR versus AND, Beta(1,1) hyperprior; exact finite beta-binomial mixture over latent world forms and per-world marginal likelihoods. No hidden true form, generator/seed, or unobserved outcomes to learner.
design.unknown: within-world independent Bernoulli(0.5) effect model, prior probability 0.1, used for rejection/abstention rather than forced classification; no learned grammar labels
design.confidence_policy: make a binary output only if posterior predictive probability >=0.99 or <=0.01; otherwise abstain. Locked before any primary source effects.
design.world_history: 16 FIT causal worlds update overhypothesis from their charged observations, independent of their hidden labels; cold freeze all FIT memory for all 32 TRANSFER worlds. SHIFT is isolated exploratory adaptation: only the first eight SHIFT worlds can update an otherwise copied prior; score only the following eight. Do not learn from TRANSFER held questions or the 32 TRANSFER world histories.
design.action_policy: Per world eight paid do-style outcomes: four common SHA256-selected demonstrator-action outcomes and four additional own actions, one at a time, selected by the model's expected reduction in posterior entropy of causal form; all actions real with identical causal authority, demonstrations are not merely passive covariations.
design.symbolic_parity: An independently implemented mathematically identical Bayesian enumeration, when available, must match hierarchical posterior/readout; parity proves no unique numerical cognitive advantage.
design.source_namespace: WSP151 only. Reserve new public synthetic ID seeds FIT 320000..320015, TRANSFER 321000..321031, SHIFT 322000..322015, OFF 323000..323007, COLD 324000..324007. No WSP135-150 replay or original protected source first-use.
design.source_distribution: Source owner preregisters 12 AND / 4 OR FIT, 24 AND / 8 OR independent TRANSFER, 4 AND / 12 OR SHIFT, eight independent structureless OFF negative worlds; permute causal subset and role IDs within worlds. The learner receives neither family counts nor truth flags.
design.held: After all three arms and models seal complete 64-state prediction vectors, independent source owner selects 16 shared never-paid x from the union-unobserved intersection. Each independent world is bootstrap unit; 32 TRANSFER worlds=512 paired held queries. No held coordinate or label enters the learner or action selector.
design.source_custody: Original public synthetic first-use requires separate source-owner authorization, branch + scientific prereg SHA, verified unchanged source-free model and dual-OS negative tests. Do not open source.py or score original cohort as part of source-free engineering. Freeze first-use attempt and any failures.
design.free_diagnostics: Fabricated-row only, no source import; exact small-n exhaustive algebra and posterior normalization, no-leakage, corrupted memory rejection, cold restore, false action provenance denial, prior reversal, independent symbolic parity.
design.provenance: record exact SHA/tree, prereg SHA, original first-use SHA and action/held hashes; preserve complete per-world paired scores, CPU/wall, freeze status and negative results.

frozen_science.primary: 32 TRANSFER worlds ×16 postseal unseen effect queries, score correct confident count and wrong confident count and abstentions; paired difference from strongest qualified same-action, same-history fully fitted CART/recurrent/symbolic/flat comparator.
frozen_science.cold_restore: 8 zero-call relabels, all persisted FIT worlds and posterior digests round-trip exactly; no effect source reads
frozen_science.shift: Diagnostic only; quantify first eight adaptation versus final eight evaluation, no shift success used to rescue failed primary
frozen_science.whole_process: Record wall/CPU, data/compute/action budgets for all arms; no GPU/energy claims absent measurement
frozen_science.decision: Any failure of primary comparison/calibration/control/provenance => NO_GO. No post-result retuning, reranking, reseeding or source replay. All positive synthetic development remains non-native and unaccepted.
